name: BI for the Business: KPIs and Applications
summary: The question comes before the tool. Understand how a company works and which number actually changes a decision.
prerequisites: No programming and no SQL required. It is the entry point of the BI track.
syllabus: What business intelligence is and why it matters
The functions of a company: finance, marketing, operations and HR
The four types of analysis, from descriptive to prescriptive
Metrics and KPIs: choosing the few that matter
Applications by sector: retail, healthcare, industry and finance

topics.title: What business intelligence is and what it is not

BI analyst, data analyst, data engineer and data scientist: who does what
The BI analyst’s skills and responsibilities
How a company works: finance, marketing, operations and human resources
Descriptive analysis: what happened
Diagnostic analysis: why it happened
Predictive analysis: what is likely to happen
Prescriptive analysis: what to do about it
Metrics and KPIs: definition, target, owner and frequency
Choosing few indicators and defending the choice
The misleading indicator: averages, vanity metrics and hidden denominators
Identifying stakeholders and what each one needs to see
Operational BI: today’s decision, the operations dashboard
Tactical BI: this month’s decision, departmental analysis
Strategic BI: this year’s decision, the board’s view
Applications in finance: risk, financial performance, fraud and customer lifetime value (CLV)
Applications in retail and e-commerce: sales, stock, campaigns and supply chain
Applications in healthcare: patient management, hospital efficiency and public health
Applications in industry: predictive maintenance, production and quality control
Compliance reporting and regulatory obligations
